issue.summary: PublishWorkflowStep writes the DITA-OT generation log twice
issue.description: EY forwards DITA-OT generation logs to Splunk or ELK. PublishWorkflowStep writes the same generation log twice for one publish. EY can publish 2,000-3,000 documents in one bulk action.
